Independent B09 result review delivered and read back in full:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/af2e6e12519e6b73b8677dec9ac1b2465a50526e/docs/research/candidates/degraded_incumbent_shadow_handover/pro_packets/20260914_b09_result_review/archive/RESPONSE.md

Fixed TASK:
https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/2510d355203b5ae7cf1a0cc1d64f276d52507702/docs/research/candidates/degraded_incumbent_shadow_handover/pro_packets/20260914_b09_result_review/TASK.md

The review supports retaining REPLACE and ending the fixed BYPASS extension at the one-pair finite-controller ceiling. It finds the proposed reversible direction PARK scientifically defensible as a current value judgment, not an empirical direction-wide negative or reviewer lifecycle permission. The prior concrete binary-comparison objection has been answered by B09. Replication remains a legitimate, unpurchased alternative under the same objective; not pursuing publication-strength claims is not by itself a reason to reject it.

The full review preserves -35.25 and +6/-30/-46/-71, increased energy in all conditions, 18 fewer EVAL invalid commits but 297 more TRAIN invalid commits, one-pair uncertainty, zero ordinary CAS and unestimated source contrasts. It separates documented technical acceptance from direct binary access and preserves incomplete cost coverage without inferring a breach or invalidating native service. No new seed, cap, host, experiment or lifecycle action is allocated by this review.

All thirteen manifest paths were accessed at their specified fixed versions. Scientific inputs remain at c493e95cb14d7c34c7877aca7119bde5f546a26f and other explicitly mapped revisions despite ordinary delivery-branch advances.

Verified commit af2e6e12519e6b73b8677dec9ac1b2465a50526e is exactly one commit above pre-write HEAD 3bfbd29cdaf8a5a7e92b3209b97f12b24224507e, adding only the authorized RESPONSE.md (60 lines, zero deletions). That parent was verified to descend from the authorized base. No project code, tests, models, experiments or other paths were changed.
